purpose: Photorealistic illustrative fish encyclopedia and catch-card assets, not actual wildlife photographs or diagnostic scientific plates.
orientation: Head left, tail right; hammerhead cephalofoils have natural slight visible foreshortening.
variants: Full runtime PNGs are byte-identical to accepted generated masters. Lossless RGBA PNG thumbnails use ImageMagick Lanczos to maximum 512 pixels. No procedural fish drawing, recoloring, upscaling or species-reuse substitution.
coordinate_system: Normalized coordinates are relative to full original canvas. Bboxes [left,top,right,bottom] have exclusive right/bottom edges. Ruler spans foremost anatomical nose/bill to farthest natural tail tip; no whisker extension.

assets.name: 长鳍金枪鱼
assets.morphology_reference: 纺锤体，极长胸鳍明显向后超过第二背鳍，背深金属蓝腹银白，尾鳍后缘白，小鳍列明显。

fact_sources.title: NOAA Fisheries: North Atlantic Albacore Tuna
fact_sources.supports: Exceptionally long pectoral fins, nearly half the body length.

fact_sources.title: NOAA: Identification of Atlantic Tunas
fact_sources.supports: Pectoral extends beyond anal fin base; ventral finlets silver or dark.

assets.name: 大西洋蓝鳍金枪鱼
assets.morphology_reference: 极粗壮纺锤体，短胸鳍不到第二背鳍，蓝黑背与银白腹，第二背鳍红褐，黄黑缘小鳍，细尾柄及新月尾。

fact_sources.title: NOAA Fisheries: Western Atlantic Bluefin Tuna
fact_sources.supports: Stocky torpedo body, color pattern, short pectoral and reddish-brown second dorsal.

assets.name: 大眼金枪鱼

fact_sources.title: NOAA: Guide to Tunas of the Western Atlantic Ocean
